value.name: asha reflects on helena serrano
value.description: Asha stands at the kitchen window and thinks through Helena Serrano's motives and the hidden significance of the note and codicil.
evidence: Asha stood at the kitchen window and looked out at the small brick yard with the wisteria over it.

She thought about a woman who had hidden her own will in her own sewing machine because she had known her older child well enough to know what he might do, and had loved him enough to leave him the chance not to.
She thought about the note in his pocket.

She thought that Helena had perhaps not entirely calculated for the possibility that he would burn the note and not look, and she thought that perhaps she had calculated for it exactly, because she had also written a letter to her daughter, and a house cannot be left to a person who refuses to find it.

value.name: rosa asks about the note
value.description: Rosa enters the kitchen and asks whether the man will be in trouble for the note.
evidence: "Will he be in trouble," Rosa said. "For the note."

value.name: asha confirms evidence destruction
value.description: Asha states that he destroyed evidence, framing the act in legal terms.
evidence: "He destroyed evidence," Asha said. "In a strict sense."

value.name: rosa asks whether a report will be made
value.description: Rosa presses Asha on whether she will report the destruction of evidence.

value.name: asha weighs reporting against harm
value.description: Asha reasons that the codicil is safe and reporting would now only cause harm, then decides to think about it.
evidence: "The codicil is intact. The note that pointed to it is gone, but the document it pointed to is in my hand. There is no longer any harm I would be preventing by reporting it. There would only be harm I would be causing."
"That is not the same as the rules."
"No," Asha said. "It is not. I am going to think about it."

value.name: rosa accepts the delay
value.description: Rosa acknowledges Asha's hesitation and lets the matter rest for the moment.

value.name: asha reveals rosa's bequest
value.description: Asha tells Rosa that Mrs. Serrano left her a bequest in the original will and implies it was more than Rosa realizes.
evidence: "Mrs. Serrano left you a bequest in the original will. She did not change that part. She left you, I think, more than you know."

value.name: rosa denies ignorance of inheritance
value.description: Rosa responds that she already knows what Helena left her, signaling guarded awareness.

value.name: asha questions whether the bequest was enough
value.description: Asha asks Rosa whether what Helena left her was sufficient, prompting a tense, measuring look.
